title: Red Interior
description: Red Interior is a horror game that was inspired from Deep Woods based off the use of top-down game mechanics. This will bring you down a linear story set in a bar where the main protagonist is trying to find a vehicle to escape being that there is something in the forest that's trying to kill him. It doesn't get any better though having many creatures seemingly exist within this bar having an extreme craving to hunt down anyone for food, especially You. To escape this nightmare the odds are not in your favor but they are odds nonetheless. Have fun and make it out alive!
description_short: In the game Red Interior, you will be constantly running and trying to find your way out of a seemingly deserted bar having five different levels each having their own gimmicks as well as most having their own music made specifically for the level. Can you make it out of this nightmare?
